title: openllmetry, openai-agents: LLM spans recorded wrong

tries.explanation: When the Agents SDK fires on_span_start for a GenerationSpanData/ResponseSpanData, _hooks.py creates an OTel LLM span and attaches it as the current context. The openai instrumentation's responses_get_or_create_wrapper then runs under that context and creates a second LLM span for the same call, doubling the count. The fix mirrors what LangChain/LiteLLM do: set SUPPRESS_LANGUAGE_MODEL_INSTRUMENTATION_KEY=True in the context when attaching the generation span, so the openai wrapper sees the suppression flag and skips creating its own span. We only apply this suppression for generation/response spans, not for agent/tool/handoff spans.

test.content:
"""Regression test: the agents instrumentation must not double-record LLM spans.

When the Agents SDK fires on_span_start for a GenerationSpanData / ResponseSpanData
the hooks.py creates one OTel LLM span *and* sets SUPPRESS_LANGUAGE_MODEL_INSTRUMENTATION_KEY
in the attached context so the openai provider instrumentation skips the same call.

This test verifies that exactly ONE "openai.response" span is emitted per
GenerationSpanData, not two.
"""
import types
import sys
from unittest.mock import MagicMock, patch

import pytest
from opentelemetry.sdk.trace import TracerProvider
from opentelemetry.sdk.trace.export.in_memory_span_exporter import InMemorySpanExporter
from opentelemetry.sdk.trace.export import SimpleSpanProcessor
from opentelemetry import context as context_api
from opentelemetry.semconv_ai import SUPPRESS_LANGUAGE_MODEL_INSTRUMENTATION_KEY


def _make_agents_stubs():
    """Install lightweight stubs for the agents package if not already present."""
    if "agents" in sys.modules:
        return

    agents_mod = types.ModuleType("agents")

    class _Base:
        pass

    class AgentSpanData(_Base):
        def __init__(self, name="test_agent"):
            self.name = name
            self.handoffs = []

    class GenerationSpanData(_Base):
        def __init__(self, model="gpt-4o"):
            self.model = model
            self.input = []
            self.response = None
            self.tools = []

    class FunctionSpanData(_Base):
        def __init__(self, name="tool"):
            self.name = name
            self.input = None
            self.output = None

    class HandoffSpanData(_Base):
        def __init__(self):
            self.from_agent = "a"
            self.to_agent = "b"

    class TracingProcessor:
        pass

    agents_mod.AgentSpanData = AgentSpanData
    agents_mod.GenerationSpanData = GenerationSpanData
    agents_mod.FunctionSpanData = FunctionSpanData
    agents_mod.HandoffSpanData = HandoffSpanData
    agents_mod.TracingProcessor = TracingProcessor

    sys.modules["agents"] = agents_mod


_make_agents_stubs()


def _make_sdk_span(span_data, trace_id="trace-1"):
    sdk_span = MagicMock()
    sdk_span.span_data = span_data
    sdk_span.trace_id = trace_id
    sdk_span.error = None
    return sdk_span


def _build_processor():
    exporter = InMemorySpanExporter()
    provider = TracerProvider()
    provider.add_span_processor(SimpleSpanProcessor(exporter))
    tracer = provider.get_tracer("test")
    from opentelemetry.instrumentation.openai_agents._hooks import OpenTelemetryTracingProcessor
    processor = OpenTelemetryTracingProcessor(tracer)
    return processor, exporter, tracer


def test_suppression_active_during_generation_span():
    from agents import GenerationSpanData

    processor, exporter, tracer = _build_processor()

    fake_trace = MagicMock()
    fake_trace.trace_id = "trace-gen-1"
    processor.on_trace_start(fake_trace)

    gen_data = GenerationSpanData(model="gpt-4o")
    sdk_span = _make_sdk_span(gen_data, trace_id="trace-gen-1")

    suppression_seen = []
    original_attach = context_api.attach

    def capturing_attach(ctx):
        val = context_api.get_value(SUPPRESS_LANGUAGE_MODEL_INSTRUMENTATION_KEY, context=ctx)
        suppression_seen.append(val)
        return original_attach(ctx)

    with patch.object(context_api, "attach", side_effect=capturing_attach):
        processor.on_span_start(sdk_span)

    processor.on_span_end(sdk_span)
    processor.on_trace_end(fake_trace)

    assert any(v is True for v in suppression_seen), (
        "SUPPRESS_LANGUAGE_MODEL_INSTRUMENTATION_KEY was not set to True when "
        "attaching the generation span context — the openai instrumentation will "
        "record a duplicate LLM span."
    )


def test_suppression_not_set_for_agent_spans():
    from agents import AgentSpanData

    processor, exporter, tracer = _build_processor()

    fake_trace = MagicMock()
    fake_trace.trace_id = "trace-agent-1"
    processor.on_trace_start(fake_trace)

    agent_data = AgentSpanData(name="my_agent")
    sdk_span = _make_sdk_span(agent_data, trace_id="trace-agent-1")

    suppression_seen = []
    original_attach = context_api.attach

    def capturing_attach(ctx):
        val = context_api.get_value(SUPPRESS_LANGUAGE_MODEL_INSTRUMENTATION_KEY, context=ctx)
        suppression_seen.append(val)
        return original_attach(ctx)

    with patch.object(context_api, "attach", side_effect=capturing_attach):
        processor.on_span_start(sdk_span)

    processor.on_span_end(sdk_span)
    processor.on_trace_end(fake_trace)

    assert not any(v is True for v in suppression_seen), (
        "SUPPRESS_LANGUAGE_MODEL_INSTRUMENTATION_KEY must not be set for agent spans."
    )


def test_one_llm_span_per_generation_span_data():
    from agents import GenerationSpanData

    processor, exporter, tracer = _build_processor()

    fake_trace = MagicMock()
    fake_trace.trace_id = "trace-count-1"
    processor.on_trace_start(fake_trace)

    for _ in range(2):
        gen_data = GenerationSpanData(model="gpt-4o")
        sdk_span = _make_sdk_span(gen_data, trace_id="trace-count-1")
        processor.on_span_start(sdk_span)
        processor.on_span_end(sdk_span)

    processor.on_trace_end(fake_trace)

    finished = exporter.get_finished_spans()
    llm_spans = [s for s in finished if s.name == "openai.response"]
    assert len(llm_spans) == 2, (
        f"Expected 2 LLM spans for 2 GenerationSpanData objects, got {len(llm_spans)}. "
        "The openai instrumentation is likely recording duplicate spans."
    )
